card.title: Don’t Go
card.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you get your train, could you taste this soup?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix that. You'll need to check again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. That's when the bread comes out.

mechanism: A creates successive food-related reasons to delay B's departure without directly requesting company.
confusable: Unlike ordinary hospitality, each reply must turn B's response into a reason not to leave yet.
comparison: D02-a uses retasting and bread timing; D02-b uses packing repair and tasting before abandonment.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
